final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), s AS (SELECT j.bats, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM j JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM j) SELECT s.bats, s.cnt, s.share, CAST(s.cnt AS REAL) / av.a FROM s JOIN av ON av.a IS NOT NULL
